summary: CI workflow (android-apk.yml) fix verified + backend regression passed. YAML parses cleanly with python yaml.safe_load. Step order confirmed: 'Set up Java' (index 2) -> 'Ensure Gradle wrapper jar' (index 6) -> 'Build self-contained debug APK' (index 7). The exact sed used in the workflow extracts Gradle version '8.14.3' from gradle-wrapper.properties. Existing /app/frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar is a valid ZIP (43,764 bytes) containing org/gradle/wrapper/GradleWrapperMain.class along with the full org/gradle/wrapper/* class set (BootstrapMainStarter, Download, Install, Logger, GradleUserHomeLookup, etc.). The official distribution URL https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.14.3-bin.zip is reachable — HEAD follows 307 -> 302 -> final HTTP 200 (content-length ~131MB, content-type application/octet-stream) without downloading the body. Backend regression: GET /api/health -> 200 {status:ok}; POST /api/translate ('Good morning' auto->fr) -> 200 with translated_text='Bonjour' and detected_source='en'; POST /api/chat -> 200 with a non-empty Chingu-style reply. No 502s. Note (agent-context): Java is not installed in this preview container, so 'gradle wrapper' / './gradlew' were intentionally NOT executed here — that only runs on the GitHub CI runner. Full end-to-end APK build must be verified by re-running the GitHub Action after the user pushes.
action_items: Push the workflow change via 'Save to GitHub' and re-run the 'Android Diagnostic APK' workflow to obtain the final end-to-end verification (assembleDebug + JS bundle embed check). The local guard-rails all pass; the definitive check is the CI green run.

Optional hardening: also commit gradle-wrapper.jar to git so the fallback step becomes a no-op (currently the jar exists locally at /app/frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar but is gitignored on CI — the new 'Ensure Gradle wrapper jar' step regenerates it, which is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow guard step 'Ensure Gradle wrapper jar' is well-scoped: uses set -euo pipefail, tests -s on the jar before regen, downloads the exact version from wrapper.properties, and re-asserts test -s on the jar after regen — good failure signal for CI.
The sed regex 's/.*gradle-\([0-9][0-9.]*\)-bin\.zip/\1/p' correctly extracts 8.14.3 and will keep working if the pin is bumped to any future 8.x/9.x version.

Since the guard runs `gradle wrapper --gradle-version <v>` in the frontend/android dir using the freshly downloaded distribution, the regenerated jar will match the pinned distributionUrl and distributionSha256Sum — no drift risk.

gradle-wrapper.jar being untracked in git is the true root cause; the workflow now compensates, but committing the jar (Gradle's own recommendation) would remove the network dependency at build time. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The .github/workflows/android-apk.yml wrapper-jar guard has been verified locally (YAML parse, step order, version parse, jar integrity, dist URL reachability HEAD-only). Java is intentionally not installed in this container, so do NOT try to execute ./gradlew or 'gradle wrapper' here — run the CI workflow on GitHub for the actual APK build. Backend /api/health, /api/translate, /api/chat all healthy against https://chingu-speak-backend.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_issue: Original CI failure: `Error: Unable to access jarfile .../frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`. Root cause: gradle-wrapper.jar is not tracked in the repository (only gradle-wrapper.properties is), so actions/checkout@v4 restored the properties file but not the jar, and `./gradlew` cannot bootstrap without the wrapper jar. Fix (verified): a new 'Ensure Gradle wrapper jar' step, placed after 'Set up Java' and before 'Build self-contained debug APK', checks for the jar; if missing, it parses the Gradle version from gradle-wrapper.properties, downloads the official gradle-<version>-bin.zip from services.gradle.org, unzips it to /tmp, and runs `gradle wrapper --gradle-version <version>` from frontend/android to regenerate a valid wrapper jar matching the pinned distributionUrl/SHA. All local prerequisites (URL reachable, version parseable, jar layout correct) confirmed.
